# CONF-005: Request ids: null is rejected and responses echo the id exactly

| Severity | Applies to | Spec section |
|---|---|---|
| error | both eras, stdio, http | [2026-07-28/basic/index#requests](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/index#requests) |

Sends a request with id null, which MUST NOT be accepted (an error or no answer both pass; a result fails). Then sends a string id with non-ASCII characters and a large integer id; responses MUST carry the same id, with the same JSON type. The rule is identical in 2025-11-25 (https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25/basic#requests). On servers that speak both eras it runs twice: once with modern requests, and once inside a legacy initialize session as <ID>@legacy.

From the command line: `mcpprobe checks explain CONF-005`. To leave it out of a run, add `"CONF-005"` to `[checks] disable` in [mcpprobe.toml](../configuration.md); to change how much it counts, use `severity_overrides`.
